tidbit: Did you know… about 15,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
New Relic integrates real-time production data into coding workflows by bringing change tracking into GitHub Copilot. Confirmed by VARIndia.
Reported by Türkiye Today: a family is suing OpenAI after ChatGPT advised an epilepsy patient to stop taking medication, which led to death.
Australia has made emotional manipulation by chatbot designs illegal, becoming the first country to pass such a law. Confirmed by Tech Times, citing concerns over teen suicide cases.
Chinese artificial intelligence firms DeepSeek and Moonshot AI used GPT-6 Astra outputs to train rival models. Confirmed by Chosunbiz amid rising access concerns.
Grok Imagine created an artificial intelligence film of the Odyssey, but according to critics reported by The Conversation, it lacks emotional depth and realism.
Free every hour.
